limitations: Rank-one linear operators of weight zero only; no higher-rank operators, orbit classification or scheme structures. Best-knowledge literature comparison may miss an equivalent tensor formulation.

title: An exact rank-one Rota–Baxter census for full matrix algebras over finite fields
